title: Add JSON Schema Request Validation Middleware
description: Introduce a lightweight, zero‑dependency middleware that validates incoming request bodies, query strings, and params against JSON Schemas defined per route. This prevents malformed data from reaching handlers, reduces boiler‑plate validation code, and improves overall security and reliability.
testCases: Validate that a POST request with a body matching the schema passes through to the handler
Validate that a POST request with a missing required field returns a 400 response with a clear error message
Validate that query string validation works and invalid queries are rejected
Validate that route‑level schemas can be combined (params + query + body) without conflict
acceptance: All new tests pass, existing test suite remains 100% green, middleware correctly returns 400 on validation failures and lets valid requests continue, and documentation is added to the README with usage examples.
reason: Ensuring data integrity at the framework level eliminates repetitive validation logic in applications, reduces bugs, and aligns with the recent stability focus, delivering immediate value to developers using yantraverse.
